entities.name: Károly Dietz

entities.summary: Károly Dietz was a Hungarian football player and manager who coached Hungary in the 1938 FIFA World Cup. He was the national football team's manager from 1934 to 1939. Dietz also played for Magyar AC and Műegyetemi AFC.
